task: Review existing family 055 Argus drafts, not the manuscripts as a new audit
version_policy: Old inputs are read-only. All 26 files exist and match their listed byte counts. Thirteen have family-9000055 entries in the preserved manifest and match those entries; thirteen are not listed in that manifest. Absence from the snapshot manifest is not a failed mathematical check. Historical certificates are evaluated against their embedded source, not relabelled as certificates for current source.
grouping_rule: One unit per mathematical argument and its stated dependency role. Copies, compiler receipts, failed compiler versions, exact-arithmetic certificates, and citation transcriptions are supporting artifacts, not independent mathematical results. The five units form one dependent Gepner construction.

units.argument: Universal real-algebra identities, separation inequalities, and support arithmetic
units.claim_scope: All real variables under the hypotheses actually displayed in each version of Main.lean; no categorical theorem.
units.version_reconciliation: Version 1 has separate endpoint lower bounds h0 and h3 and admits an exact scalar counterexample. Version 2 uses the correct combined bound hends on n0+n3 but still fails noncomputability declarations. Version 3 adds the noncomputable section and succeeds. Only A12 embeds the current source and current fidelity text; the current actual-object argument derives the combined bound.

units.argument: Actual torsion pairs, bounded HRS hearts, slope-cut comparison, and the spherical twist
units.claim_scope: Smooth complex quintic with the stated coherent-sheaf background and Xu input: independent-endpoint comparison for 0<u<13/46 on some square, and at uG on the square of radius 1/4000.

units.argument: Actual common-heart vanishing and independent-endpoint fifth-step refinement
units.claim_scope: At u=uG, Phi^3 U_alpha is contained in U_beta[1] for both independent endpoints in the open square of radius 1/500000, using categorical Phi^5=[2].

units.argument: Block sectors and support, finite block filtrations, slicing, endpoints, and local finiteness
units.claim_scope: Unperturbed fifth-step blocks have full numerical l1 and Euclidean support constant 30000000; the proposed construction has finite refinements, a Gepner-equivariant slicing, both endpoint conventions, and finite-length quasi-abelian intervals of width less than one.

units.argument: Assembly and attribution of the normalized Gepner stability condition
units.claim_scope: Conditional complete stability-condition theorem on every smooth complex quintic, with the three quantitative strengthenings; not a result about the separate large-volume manuscript.
units.version_reconciliation: The natural statement is unchanged through versions 1-4. Version 2 adds XU_1_3; version 3 also adds PHI_PERIOD; version 4 also adds STANDARD_GEOMETRY. None is a separate proof.
